hunks.new:
current-release-return-rtl:
    if: ${{ inputs.route == 'current-release-return-rtl' }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    runs-on: xcode-27
    timeout-minutes: 150
    env:
      DEVELOPER_DIR: /Applications/Xcode_27.app/Contents/Developer
      PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: '1'
      GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS: '0'
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      EVIDENCE: build/current-apple-release-return-rtl-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}/evidence
    steps:
      - name: Checkout the exact current App and controller source
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Bind the dispatched local branch without advancing its commit
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
          test "$GITHUB_REF" = "refs/heads/$GITHUB_REF_NAME"
          test "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" = "codex/chatgpt-wave15-shared-20261121"
          current_branch="$(git branch --show-current)"
          if [ -z "$current_branch" ]; then
            git switch -c "$GITHUB_REF_NAME"
          else
            test "$current_branch" = "$GITHUB_REF_NAME"
          fi
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
      - name: Select native ARM64 Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
          architecture: arm64
      - name: Checkout the exact public canonical Hanlin source
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: davidpovarsky/hanlin-ai
          ref: 116cc6be0654a5d11bc56ba00e0310031107ee36
          path: .ci/hanlin-source
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Build the current App once and execute only this fixed unresolved scope
        id: execute
        timeout-minutes: 130
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 -B Tools/CurrentAppleValidation/release_return_rtl.py execute --expected-source "$GITHUB_SHA"
      - name: Finalize only journaled current-run resources even after an early failure
        if: ${{ always() && steps.execute.outcome != 'skipped' }}
        timeout-minutes: 8
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 -B Tools/CurrentAppleValidation/release_return_rtl.py cleanup --expected-source "$GITHUB_SHA"
      - name: Preserve original Products, commands, results and cleanup without filtering raw streams
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: Current-Anytype-Release-Return-RTL-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            ${{ env.EVIDENCE }}
          retention-days: 30
          if-no-files-found: error
